parsed.name: 标准帧源
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件帧源组件，用于按 frameWrangler 的轮询周期发出图像帧，并通过回调机制把帧组事件提供给漂移跟踪等图像处理逻辑。它用于组织和分发相机帧数据，本身不直接代表具体硬件仪器。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software frame-source component that emits image frames once per frameWrangler polling interval and provides frame-group events to drift-tracking and related image-processing logic via callbacks. It is used to organize and distribute camera frame data and does not itself represent a specific hardware instrument.

actions.description: 触发一次轮询周期的帧发射或更新。
actions.description_en: Trigger one polling-cycle frame emission or update.

actions.description: 连接一个回调函数以接收帧源事件。
actions.description_en: Connect a callback to receive frame-source events.

actions.description: 断开一个已连接的回调函数。
